title: The Israeli military has demolished a hospital in Lebanon. According to a statement from Lebanon's Ministry of Health, Ghandour Hospital in Al-Nabatiyah Al-Fawqa was entirely wiped out in Israeli airstrikes.
text: The Israeli military has demolished a hospital in Lebanon. According to a statement from Lebanon's Ministry of Health, Ghandour Hospital in Al-Nabatiyah Al-Fawqa was entirely wiped out in Israeli airstrikes.
